images.titre: File:Apostle Andrew from Hajdudorog.JPG
images.objet: Apostle Andrew from Hajdudorog
images.description: The picture is a Greek Catholic icon depicting apostle Andrew with his typical cross with him. The icon was painted in the end of the 18th century as part of the iconostasis of the Greek Catholic Cathedral of Hajdúdorog, Hungary. Andrew's icon is placed on the second tier of the iconostasis, the so called Twelve Apostles tier. This icon is the third painting from the left.
